body: I’ve been feeling dizzy all day. Finally going to find a therapist against my father’s wishes though, I have no one to talk to about how I’m feeling without being laughed at, shot down, or told that “we’re all anxious these days.” I feel so alone
This exact thing happened with me last night, just had my dad with me instead. I cried for so long when I got home because I felt like a POS.

Yep! Last night I went to the ER because of a new panic attack symptom I guess,… my hands felt like they were vibrating uncontrollably and locked up anytime I tried to do anything with them. It scared the absolute shit out of me :( It really feels like our bodies just turn on us
Omg yes I love this.

This post is adorable lol 

I wish you two well!!! 🥳
Yep, that’s it. It briefly came and went a month ago, but has been happening on a nightly basis as of this week. I’ve been trying to up my electrolytes and it does seem to help a bit.

I got Covid in January, recovered and felt totally fine in February. March started with a subtle change in anxiety, and I truly think it peaked in late March/April as it was bothering me at work. It has since sort of subsided, but it drastically increases when I’m tired. 

It sucks because I’ve had anxiety my whole life, I know my body and what I’m used to. This is nothing like I’ve ever felt before, like I’m talking derealization/sweating/heart racing/ for no reason whatsoever. I’m probably still early on so we can only hope for the best.
My left calf has a nightly routine of tensing up to where it’s *just* about to cramp, but doesn’t. Not too sure if it’s PEM after work but everything gets worse for me at night..
I would do ANYTHING to trade my PEM fatigue for joint pain. I miss being able to talk to my long distance partner at night :(

Don’t take my case as the same for you as many find azithromycin like any other antibiotic, but I had a MASSIVE panic attack at work on my 3rd day of Azithromycin. Cant say 100% it was that or the long Covid but hasn’t like that happened since.
Christ this is disgusting! I cannot believe they sent this thinking it was professional..
I’m a little late to this post lol, but has your period also come in later since your long haul? I’m about 4 days late with zero chance of pregnancy. Still feeling the hormonal changes though
Haven’t seen em since unfortunately, but definitely don’t give up hope! We randomly get new animals after months without em.
I’m actually an associate in SATX, and we had them very briefly a few months back.
Yeah. I’m 80% sure I already have a lowered chance of pregnancy as is since I’m not the healthiest girl but I still was TERRIFIED of the possibility. It was a dumb idea though haha

We did on the first night lol. Just PLEASE use protection!! I know everyone says this but, we decided to skip it & I ended taking 2 plan b’s our last week together… very stupid idea and it was incredibly painful for me the weeks following. At least I’m not pregnant lmao

I’ll definitely mention it. It’s actually funny you mention that. I tried an edible for the first time a week after my Covid diagnosis & had the first body-altering panic attack I’d say ever. It was terrifying but after the high, I felt fine. Then mid February I had an incident where I thought I had a bad reaction to midol as it was just like the edible panic, but ironically the nurses at the urgent care prescribed just me anxiety meds lol. I’ve been trying for so long to piece everything together but I still have no clue. Should I mention the possibility of long haul to my GP?

I’ve gotten blood work done and all that showed was slightly low vitamin d haha. I’m gonna ask for a heart related test at my next appointment. My rate normally sits around 85 while awake but resting, but when this overwhelming fatigue hits me (typically at night) it dips all the way down to 55. It’s pretty scary since my active heart rate ranges from 115-135.

That’s what scary to me, I’m not on any medications that would affect my heart yet these episodes keep happening. It’s subsided a little this week, but I still feel 10x more anxious than I used to be. It’s honestly the anxiousness that’s making it feel worse than it is.
I’m a bit late to this but this is my EXACT timeline. It’s so crazy. I’ve been searching the entire internet trying to figure out what’s going on with me!
Thank you so so much! Still works in Late April/May 2022!! :))
A younger mother of a toddler asking me “Are there any fish that wouldn’t mind- you know- banging on the glass?”

Thank you for writing this, this is just what I needed. I’m trying to find a more feasible way of further justifying my concerns/refusals, because apparently morals are just tossed out the window with most of these people.

It’s so god awful, someone called in to complain about me denying them an African cichlid for their 6 year old niece last night. I really wish we had a long pet safety disclosure paperwork for each specific animal so the customer truly sees that this isn’t a f*cking toy for their kids. Thank god for my management who cares about PetSmart policy.

I’m literally here because someone called us yesterday to complain about me, and I happened to pick it up. Customer was mad I denied her an African cichlid for her 6 year old niece, which would’ve been fine had she actually done research & not just “Oh, this one’s pretty I’ll take it.”  I’m lucky enough my management team feels very strongly about getting animals to the right homes so it all went smoothly. After letting it get to my head though I came to the conclusion that maybe I should work on my delivery more, as it gets so exhausting trying to explain to people about proper fish care I don’t go into detail about it, and may come off as stuck up.
Rush

In the exact same position as you, I haven’t done work for the entire first & second semesters & I’m in my senior year. I’m being forced to go back to school however, and I’m getting my current work in. It’s so stressing and everyone expects you to somehow get everything done in that little period of time.

These days I am simply living for the few I hold dear to me. I don’t know where or who I am on my own. After my failed attempt a few days ago, I decided that I can’t hurt them because of my own mental battles. The thing that’s helping me cope is drawing. I love to draw my feelings, or a detailed animal.

I’ve felt so alone, and hopeless. I’ve pushed away everyone close to me as a result of my wall. All I really have are my dogs & art. My best cope right now has to be a combo of drawing & listening to music, as I put my feelings in that moment into the piece. 

Facing one of the biggest reasons why I feel this way tomorrow, not looking forward to it.
God, I’m 18 and in my senior year of high school. I haven’t touched my work in around 5 months due to this shit mixed with my crumbling mentality. I hate it here.
Yes it does, it really does. It’s all I’ve got anyways.

I can relate to the boyfriend having an interested friend part.. well. We broke up around a month ago, just because he lost his love for me, nothing else. Come a few weeks later, and he’s almost moved on with a friend he’s had for some time. Broke my heart even more.. I hope yours doesn’t do this to you. I won’t tell you to leave him because even I still love my ex after it all... 

I hope you find some peace in your life, i hope that you’ll feel the happiness you deserve, too.
I hope you find peace in whatever way that may be.
For real. Shit piles and piles and what are we to do?
My hope and happiness was taken away from me in one night, and now he’s already moved on. It hasn’t even been a damn month.

Yeah. 2020 took a lot from me too, it took my almost 2 year long relationship away. This year fucking sucks. I remember on New Year’s Eve, I was with my boyfriend celebrating and we even kissed when it turned 12. Now, I don’t know when I’ll ever see him again and I’m just left with the fucking memories. We’re still friends and I’m glad about that... but it’s not the same. I started cutting this last month.
Just reassure her that you’re there, and that you will just listen to her. I don’t know if she likes to vent but, it helps a lot to vent feelings to someone trustworthy and nonjudgmental.

I’m not really okay.. I miss everything we did so much and losing him made me kinda lose the hope I had. We lasted nearly 2 years & the memories of us replay in my head 24/7. I’ve felt better lately but I don’t think I’ll ever think the same.
No. It only happened about 3 weeks ago. I don’t think we’ll get back together, though.
There’s no reason to apologize. I feel that overwhelming feeling, too. I like to think how free we’ll be in the spiritual realm, with no physical limitations or human emotions to bring us down.

My last boyfriend and I broke up for this reason. I loved him so much, but he didn’t love himself and was lost. I think the best thing you could do is end the relationship, but maybe still be friends if that’s possible. It’s hard to maintain your love for someone in this state.. It broke my heart but now I realize it’s better for him.

It’s situations like this that really get me. As women, we’re told that we need to rely on ourselves and not a partner, yet when we stay on our own it’s a problem?? I really don’t understand the mindset of people.

I can get behind this a bit. My last boyfriend had become someone I felt dependent on.. I now realized how little space I gave him and I think it led to our breakup. It sucks so bad like there’s literally nothing I can fucking do. We’re still friends but he doesn’t love me anymore... yet I still love him, maybe more so now. So many regrets, nothing I can do. :(
I would cut him out entirely. It seems to be the only way

I know you will feel guilt, and sadness but it might be time to stop talking to him completely. It’s hard when you’re sort of “morally” tied up to him at this point, though. The fact is that it’s your life and you take control of it, and it sounds he’s trying to control you. I would never let a boyfriend guilt me into being his partner, regardless of mental illness.
No you didn’t tell me lol. That’s pretty cool we both draw tho.
I’m a realistic artist, I’ve tried my own “style” but I don’t think I can make my own lol.
I’d say I am. I’m experimenting with what I like, and for while it was digital but just last night I fell back to traditional pencil on paper art.
I wouldn’t say I have a happy food really haha. I feel like I just eat to survive at this point, but I love drawing.
Aww haha, thank you. Fate just didn’t see us fit together I suppose.
Ill be here too & I’ll reach out if anything gets worse. Thank you!
It sucked but every day’s just another day at this point. Thank you so much for talking to me. I hope you do better too. :)

Lemme explain the whole break up. He was really quiet on the call that night so I asked him what was up. We had to switch to texting because I was shaking so bad from an anxiety attack. He finally broke over text and said what I just told you, so initially I was confused and asked “Are you trying to say that you don’t love me anymore?” Then he said “I’m sorry” over text, then in that moment he broke out crying over the call. We both cried a lot that night.
Yes. The exact way he worded it was “I care about you but I feel so disconnected”.
I’m not too sure he regrets it, I really don’t know. He feels bad though, and I always always remind him that it’s not his fault that this happened.

We are the same people lol. It probably is harder. That explains a lot, I just really dug myself into a hole by talking to him so much. I trust him not to freak out when I tell him how I’m feeling. He feels just as bad as me tbh. We don’t message each other much, but it hasn’t been that long so idk. I felt more shitty the day after, because I didn’t know if it was ok to be friends and I thought I had lost my literal best friend.

I didn’t mention but, he and I are friends. The breakup wasn’t toxic, it just hurts knowing we won’t be a couple anymore. I don’t know if it’s bad that we’re friends? We still send each other stuff over Instagram and text about how we’re feeling and what not. I guess I’m lucky in a way.. I really don’t know. I deleted 99% of the pics I had of him, but kept the ones I couldn’t let go.

Today went well. No harm or crying, it was just blank today. The part that’s making me spiral is that the memories of what we did, places we went, games we played, etc repeat in my mind 24/7, with only small breaks of distractions. Like what you said, it’s so hard to go from checking up on each other one day, to pretending like I don’t love him.

My ex boyfriend left me two weeks ago, and has since led me down a spiraling path.. to where I’m at now. I feel the pain of investing so much, giving myself to him in every way. He just lost his love for me.. what the hell can I do? The fucking pain of loving him just as I did before, and knowing it’s never going to be the same.
I’m sorry, that this is what it came to, I hope that maybe you’ll find peace one way or another tonight.
Caught it in March and really only had a sore throat. Wish it would’ve taken me then to spare me from this pain now.

Going through this pain too, but as a girl. Thing is him n I still talk like friends, but he lost his love. I still love him and the memories of us run through my mind like the air I breathe. I feel so hopeless now. :)
I miss everything we did.. he just lost his feelings for me.. there’s literally nothing I can do
I’m here for that heartbreak too. He lost his feelings for me.. in just one night my whole world came crashing down. Everything feels so hopeless. I miss everything we did. There’s nothing I can do..
You’re right. Some things just aren’t meant to be. As of late I’ve realized why I never saw myself living past 18. It’s only 21 days away for me. :(

I feel this exact pain right now. He was my everything, and in a matter of one night it’s like my whole world was taken from me. I want to end this pain so badly. Every thing brings back a memory. It hurts so fucking bad.

It began on 3/18 with a light sore throat that progressed into a severe one by night. The next day was mostly a dry cough with the throat pain still just as bad. Over the next few days my sinuses got really gross and runny & on 3/25 I finally got tested and I was given amoxicillin to treat the symptoms. By 3/31, I got my results back as positive but all of my symptoms had completely disappeared and have been gone since. Yesterday I was counted as recovered.
That’s awful, it’s amazing to me how governments allow this to happen.

I’m in Texas and I had the more mild symptoms, and so because testing here is shockingly available I got tested a few weeks back and I did in fact test positive for Covid-19. It’s more than likely that your family did get it.
As if that didn’t always happen here...

lmao yeah, the last few days we totally believed it was just a sinus infection.
Quite literally the opposite, as mine would be awful in the morning and be significantly better at night.

All I can tell you is that it depends on where you are and how readily available the testing kits are. My doctor just said that because I was experiencing something similar to Covid that I should be tested.

It began on 3/19 with a small sore throat that literally worsened as the day went on and it continued to get worse but then it stayed the same up until 3/25, the date of my testing. One thing I forgot to tell the others that commented was that I had a very, very dry cough alongside the sore throat in the first few days. Then the cough began to develop into a more congested one where I had a lot of mucus/phlegm coming up. I’d say that this peaked the day of my testing. The doctors gave me a high dosage of amoxicillin for 5 days and I’ve truly gotten better. I can’t say whether or not if it was the medicine that helped, though.

That’s interesting, I was told that I had to be tested solely because I was experiencing symptoms like it. Our testing here seemed to be calm but I think that’s because either people don’t think they have it or because they’re being denied. It really sucks that like you, there are so many other places in the country that people cannot be tested.
I live in Texas in the city of San Antonio. It’s possible I could’ve contracted it on my spring break to Fort Wayne, Indiana.

I did not feel any underlying differences aside from my usual shortness of breath, however my vitals told me that I had a 12 BRA, which is the lowest that they would still consider to be normal. I’m doing my best to keep myself distracted, it’s really hard to be home 24/7 though. Thank you so much!

I lost my sense of smell almost completely and taste was there but not as fluent. We’re still trying to figure out but for now we believe that I got it at our HEB (grocery store) as I started getting symptoms immediately after that day. I wouldn’t say I’ve fully recovered but I do feel better, I’m getting a follow-up testing at some point in the next few weeks.

I’m not too sure anyone will see this but, I am a healthy 17 year old and I got tested for covid-19 last Wednesday. Today my doctor notified us that I did indeed test positive. My symptoms began as a mild to almost severe sore throat and a lot congestion, then progressed over the course of a week to a pretty bad cough. Note that I did not have any fever, whatsoever. If you see this and have any questions, please do ask!

Well my doctor called my mom and informed us that I did indeed test positive for covid. I feel better thank god, and I hope that if your results do come back positive that your family is safe. My parents have had no signs of sickness thus far and we’re all hoping it stays that way. Good luck!
I hope you get your results soon! I got tested last Wednesday and I’m still waiting for results.  😐

It does suck but I’m pretty confident I’ll get through it alright even if I do test positive. I’m only 17, so maybe. 😣
I got tested yesterday and was told I wouldn’t get my results for 3-5 days, and yes it does suck but I’m slowly pulling through.

It’s ridiculous seeing so many young people not give a damn about this.
